.wp-site-blocks > header, .wp-site-blocks > footer, header.wp-block-template-part, footer.wp-block-template-part, .wp-block-template-part:first-child { display: none !important; }
.wp-block-post-title, .wp-block-spacer { display: none !important; }
html, body, .wp-site-blocks { background: #F5F4EF !important; background-color: #F5F4EF !important; }
.wp-site-blocks, .wp-site-blocks > main, .wp-site-blocks > main > .wp-block-group, .wp-site-blocks .is-layout-constrained, .wp-site-blocks .is-layout-constrained > :where(:not(.alignleft):not(.alignright):not(.alignfull)), .has-global-padding, .entry-content { max-width: none !important; padding-left: 0 !important; padding-right: 0 !important; margin-left: 0 !important; margin-right: 0 !important; padding-top: 0 !important; }

:root{
  --bone:#F5F4EF; --surface:#FAFAF7; --card:#F1EFE8; --line:#E6E1D6;
  --navy:#1F3864; --navy-dark:#16294a; --navy-light:#2B4A7A; --teal:#2E7D74; --teal-light:#70C49C;
  --ink:#20242B; --ink-mid:#3A372F; --muted:#5F5A50; --kick:#9A8F78;
  --font-body:'DM Sans',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Inter,sans-serif;
  --maxw:1180px;
}
#pacerai-homepage *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
#pacerai-homepage{width:100%;max-width:100vw;overflow-x:hidden;font-family:var(--font-body);background:var(--bone);color:var(--ink);font-size:15px;line-height:1.65;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
#pacerai-homepage a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
#pacerai-homepage img{max-width:100%}

#pacerai-homepage nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 32px;height:64px;background:rgba(245,244,239,.86);backdrop-filter:saturate(1.4) blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
#pacerai-homepage .nav-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-weight:800;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:-.2px;color:var(--ink);justify-self:start}
#pacerai-homepage .nav-logo .chev{height:15px;width:auto;fill:none;stroke:var(--navy);stroke-width:2.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
#pacerai-homepage .nav-logo span{color:var(--teal)}
#pacerai-homepage .nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;list-style:none;justify-self:center}
#pacerai-homepage .nav-links a{display:inline-block;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:8px;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;color:#494540;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}
#pacerai-homepage .nav-links a:hover{background:#ebe8df;color:var(--ink)}
#pacerai-homepage .nav-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;justify-self:end}
#pacerai-homepage .btn-login{padding:9px 14px;border-radius:9px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--navy);background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line)}
#pacerai-homepage .btn-login:hover{border-color:var(--navy)}
#pacerai-homepage .btn-cta{padding:9px 16px;border-radius:9px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:#fff;background:var(--navy);border:1px solid var(--navy);white-space:nowrap}
#pacerai-homepage .btn-cta:hover{background:var(--navy-dark)}
#pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:8px}
#pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn span{display:block;width:22px;height:2px;background:var(--ink-mid);border-radius:2px}

#pacerai-homepage .hero{text-align:left;padding:120px 24px 24px;max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto}
#pacerai-homepage .kick{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--kick);font-weight:700}
#pacerai-homepage .hero h1{font-size:clamp(32px,5.4vw,48px);line-height:1.14;margin:16px 0 0;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.6px;color:var(--ink);max-width:960px}
#pacerai-homepage .rotor{display:inline-block;color:var(--teal)}
#pacerai-homepage .for-rotor{white-space:nowrap}
#pacerai-homepage .hero-sub{font-size:18px;color:var(--ink-mid);max-width:680px;margin:20px 0 0;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600}

#pacerai-homepage .proof{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:34px auto 0;padding:0 24px}
#pacerai-homepage .stats{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:40px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:22px}
#pacerai-homepage .stat{text-align:center}
#pacerai-homepage .stat b{display:block;font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:-.3px}
#pacerai-homepage .stat span{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:1.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--kick);font-weight:700}
#pacerai-homepage .marquee{overflow:hidden;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 8%,#000 92%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 8%,#000 92%,transparent)}
#pacerai-homepage .track{display:flex;gap:52px;width:max-content;align-items:center;animation:paceScroll 24s linear infinite}
#pacerai-homepage .track:hover{animation-play-state:paused}
@keyframes paceScroll{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
#pacerai-homepage .track img{height:38px;width:auto;object-fit:contain;opacity:.72;filter:grayscale(1)}

#pacerai-homepage .showcase-wrap{padding:40px 24px 30px}
#pacerai-homepage .showcase{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;padding:16px;background:#274a72 url('https://getpacerai.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/tahoe-bg.jpg') center 40%/cover no-repeat;box-shadow:0 34px 100px rgba(10,20,45,.34)}
#pacerai-homepage .showcase iframe{display:block;width:100%;height:620px;border:0;background:transparent}

#pacerai-homepage .wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
#pacerai-homepage .steps{margin:40px auto 30px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
#pacerai-homepage .steps b{color:var(--navy)}
#pacerai-homepage .tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin:0 auto 20px}
#pacerai-homepage .tile{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:22px;background:var(--surface)}
#pacerai-homepage .tile h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:16px;color:var(--navy)}
#pacerai-homepage .tile p{margin:0;color:#5a5648;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}

#pacerai-homepage .band{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:64px 24px 8px}
#pacerai-homepage .band .eyebrow{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--kick);font-weight:700}
#pacerai-homepage .band h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,30px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.4px;margin:8px 0 8px;color:var(--ink)}
#pacerai-homepage .band .lede{font-size:16px;color:var(--muted);max-width:660px;line-height:1.55;margin:0}
#pacerai-homepage .draft{display:inline-block;margin-left:8px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9a6b3f;background:#f3e6d6;border:1px solid #e6ccac;border-radius:5px;padding:2px 6px;font-weight:700;vertical-align:middle}

#pacerai-homepage .usecases{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;margin-top:26px}
#pacerai-homepage .uc{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface);padding:26px}
#pacerai-homepage .uc h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:19px;color:var(--navy)}
#pacerai-homepage .uc p{margin:0;color:#5a5648;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.55}
#pacerai-homepage .uc ul{margin:14px 0 0;padding-left:18px;color:#5a5648;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7}

#pacerai-homepage .case-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr;gap:18px;margin-top:26px}
#pacerai-homepage .case-quote{border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:3px solid var(--teal);border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface);padding:28px}
#pacerai-homepage .case-quote blockquote{font-size:20px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
#pacerai-homepage .case-quote .attr{margin-top:16px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
#pacerai-homepage .case-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface);padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
#pacerai-homepage .case-card h3{font-size:18px;color:var(--navy);margin:0 0 8px}
#pacerai-homepage .case-card p{font-size:14px;color:#5a5648;line-height:1.55}
#pacerai-homepage .case-card a{display:inline-block;margin-top:14px;color:var(--teal);font-weight:700;font-size:14px}

#pacerai-homepage .integ-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:26px}
#pacerai-homepage .integ{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface);padding:20px 16px}
#pacerai-homepage .integ h4{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal);font-weight:700;margin:0 0 10px}
#pacerai-homepage .integ ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
#pacerai-homepage .integ li{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-mid);padding:3px 0}

#pacerai-homepage .sec-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px 40px;margin-top:24px;max-width:920px}
#pacerai-homepage .sec-item{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}
#pacerai-homepage .sec-item .dot{margin-top:8px;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal);flex-shrink:0}
#pacerai-homepage .sec-item p{font-size:15px;color:var(--ink-mid);line-height:1.55}
#pacerai-homepage .sec-item b{color:var(--navy)}

#pacerai-homepage .value-tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:26px}
#pacerai-homepage .vtile{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface);padding:26px}
#pacerai-homepage .vtile .vk{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:1.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--kick);font-weight:700}
#pacerai-homepage .vtile h3{font-size:19px;color:var(--navy);margin:8px 0 8px}
#pacerai-homepage .vtile p{font-size:14.5px;color:#5a5648;line-height:1.55}

#pacerai-homepage .band .cta-inline{display:inline-block;margin-top:20px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-weight:700;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:11px;font-size:15px}
#pacerai-homepage .band .cta-inline:hover{background:var(--navy-dark)}
#pacerai-homepage .team-note{font-size:17px;color:var(--ink-mid);max-width:720px;line-height:1.6;margin:18px 0 0}
#pacerai-homepage .team-note b{color:var(--navy)}
#pacerai-homepage .team-link{display:inline-block;margin-top:18px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:var(--teal)}

#pacerai-homepage .faq-list{max-width:760px;margin:22px auto 0}
#pacerai-homepage .faq-list details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:16px 0}
#pacerai-homepage .faq-list summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:15.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px}
#pacerai-homepage .faq-list summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
#pacerai-homepage .faq-list summary::after{content:"+";font-size:20px;color:var(--teal)}
#pacerai-homepage .faq-list details[open] summary::after{content:"\2212"}
#pacerai-homepage .faq-list details p{padding:12px 0 4px;font-size:15.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}

#pacerai-homepage .cta{text-align:center;padding:66px 24px 40px;max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto}
#pacerai-homepage .cta .eyebrow{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--kick);font-weight:700}
#pacerai-homepage .cta h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,30px);font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin:10px 0 6px;letter-spacing:-.3px}
#pacerai-homepage .cta p{color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;margin:0 auto 22px;max-width:520px}
#pacerai-homepage .cta-buttons{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
#pacerai-homepage .btn-primary{display:inline-block;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-weight:700;padding:15px 30px;border-radius:11px;font-size:16px}
#pacerai-homepage .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--navy-dark)}
#pacerai-homepage .btn-outline{display:inline-block;background:transparent;color:var(--navy);border:1px solid var(--navy);font-weight:700;padding:14px 28px;border-radius:11px;font-size:16px}
#pacerai-homepage .btn-outline:hover{background:rgba(31,56,100,.06)}

#pacerai-homepage footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);padding:64px 24px 32px}
#pacerai-homepage .footer-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:260px repeat(4,1fr);gap:40px;max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding-bottom:40px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
#pacerai-homepage .footer-brand p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;margin-top:14px}
#pacerai-homepage .footer-col-head{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-mid);margin-bottom:18px}
#pacerai-homepage .footer-col ul{list-style:none}
#pacerai-homepage .footer-col li{margin-bottom:10px}
#pacerai-homepage .footer-col a{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
#pacerai-homepage .footer-col a:hover{color:var(--teal)}
#pacerai-homepage .footer-bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;max-width:var(--maxw);margin:24px auto 0}
#pacerai-homepage .footer-bottom .copy{font-size:12px;color:var(--kick)}
#pacerai-homepage .footer-bottom .legal{display:flex;gap:22px}
#pacerai-homepage .footer-bottom .legal a{font-size:12px;color:var(--kick)}

.how{--bone:#F5F4EF;--surface:#FAFAF7;--border:#E6E1D6;--ink:#20242B;--muted:#5F5A50;--kick:#9A8F78;--navy:#1F3864;--teal:#2E7D74;font-family:var(--font-body);background:var(--bone);color:var(--ink);font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;padding:24px 24px 56px !important}
.how *,.how *::before,.how *::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
@keyframes pipeBounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-6px)}}
@keyframes pipeFlow{0%{offset-distance:0%;opacity:0}10%{opacity:1}90%{opacity:1}100%{offset-distance:100%;opacity:0}}
@keyframes pipeGlow{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(31,56,100,.08)}50%{box-shadow:0 12px 44px rgba(31,56,100,.15)}}
@keyframes pipeNumFloat{0%{transform:translateX(-60px);opacity:0}15%{opacity:.08}85%{opacity:.08}100%{transform:translateX(1100px);opacity:0}}
.how .pipe-wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto !important}
.how .pipe-eyebrow{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--kick);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px !important;text-align:center}
.how h2{font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,40px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.5px;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.16;text-align:center}
.how h2 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--teal)}
.how .pipe-lead{font-size:17px;color:var(--muted);max-width:640px;line-height:1.55;text-align:center;margin:18px auto 0 !important}
.how .pipe-visual{position:relative;margin-top:60px !important;height:340px;background:var(--bone)}
.how .pipe-sources{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-around;gap:12px;width:130px;z-index:2}
.how .pipe-src-box{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:var(--navy);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 8px !important;animation:pipeBounce 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.how .pipe-src-box:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.5s}.how .pipe-src-box:nth-child(3){animation-delay:1s}.how .pipe-src-box:nth-child(4){animation-delay:1.5s}
.how .pipe-src-label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
.how .pipe-svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:1}
.how .pipe-flow-path{fill:none;stroke:var(--border);stroke-width:1.5;stroke-dasharray:6 4}
.how .pipe-dot{position:absolute;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(31,56,100,.5);offset-distance:0%;animation:pipeFlow 3s linear infinite;z-index:3}
.how .pipe-dot.pd2{animation-delay:.4s}.how .pipe-dot.pd3{animation-delay:.8s}.how .pipe-dot.pd4{animation-delay:1.2s}
.how .pipe-dot.po1{animation-delay:.2s;background:var(--teal)}.how .pipe-dot.po2{animation-delay:.6s;background:var(--teal)}.how .pipe-dot.po3{animation-delay:1s;background:var(--teal)}
.how .pipe-center{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:190px;height:190px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--navy);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;z-index:4;animation:pipeGlow 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.how .pipe-center-name{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.3px;color:var(--ink);margin-top:6px !important}
.how .pipe-center-name span{color:var(--navy)}
.how .pipe-center-sub{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.8px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.how .pipe-outputs{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;bottom:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-around;gap:12px;width:280px;z-index:2;align-items:flex-end}
.how .pipe-out-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.how .pipe-out-plus{color:var(--navy);font-size:16px;font-weight:800}
.how .pipe-out-box{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;color:var(--teal);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:12px !important;width:120px;height:90px;text-align:center}
.how .pipe-out-label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
.how .pipe-out-box.pob-navy{background:rgba(31,56,100,.9);border-color:rgba(31,56,100,.52);color:#fff}
.how .pipe-out-box.pob-navy .pipe-out-label{color:rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.how .pipe-out-box.pob-green{background:rgba(33,115,70,.88);border-color:rgba(33,115,70,.5);color:#fff}
.how .pipe-out-box.pob-green .pipe-out-label{color:rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.how .pipe-out-box.pob-orange{background:rgba(217,119,87,.92);border-color:rgba(217,119,87,.52);color:#fff}
.how .pipe-out-box.pob-orange .pipe-out-label{color:rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.how .pipe-nums{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;z-index:0}
.how .pipe-num-particle{position:absolute;font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);opacity:0;animation:pipeNumFloat 10s linear forwards;white-space:nowrap}

@media(max-width:900px){
  #pacerai-homepage nav{grid-template-columns:1fr auto;padding:0 16px}
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-links{display:none}
  #pacerai-homepage nav.nav-open .nav-links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:fixed;top:64px;left:0;right:0;background:var(--bone);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(15,25,45,.10);padding:10px 16px 16px;gap:0;z-index:130}
  #pacerai-homepage nav.nav-open .nav-links li{width:100%}
  #pacerai-homepage nav.nav-open .nav-links a{display:block;width:100%;padding:14px 6px;font-size:16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:0}
  #pacerai-homepage nav.nav-open .mobile-menu-btn span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(7px) rotate(45deg)}
  #pacerai-homepage nav.nav-open .mobile-menu-btn span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
  #pacerai-homepage nav.nav-open .mobile-menu-btn span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg)}
  #pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn span{transition:transform .2s,opacity .2s}
  #pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn{display:flex}
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-login{display:none}
  #pacerai-homepage .hero h1{font-size:30px}
  #pacerai-homepage .tiles,#pacerai-homepage .usecases,#pacerai-homepage .case-grid,#pacerai-homepage .value-tiles,#pacerai-homepage .sec-list{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  #pacerai-homepage .integ-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  #pacerai-homepage .showcase iframe{height:520px}
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-top{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px}
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-brand{grid-column:1/-1}
}
@media(max-width:768px){
  .how .pipe-visual{height:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:32px;padding:20px 0 !important}
  .how .pipe-sources,.how .pipe-outputs{position:static;width:100%;flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
  .how .pipe-center{position:static;transform:none;width:150px;height:150px;margin:0 auto !important}
  .how .pipe-svg,.how .pipe-dot,.how .pipe-nums{display:none}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#pacerai-homepage *,.how *{animation:none !important;transition:none !important;scroll-behavior:auto !important}}

/* --- a2o + responsive (bone_v3-simple) --- */

#pacerai-homepage{--sub:#A79E8C;--red:#C0392B}

  <h2>Frequently Asked Questions</h2>

    <details><summary>What size companies do you work with?</summary><p>Pacer AI works with companies that have at least $10M in recurring or contracted revenue — including non-tech companies. Alongside B2B SaaS, we work with payroll providers, commercial and residential service companies, and healthcare companies.</p></details>
    <details><summary>How long does the initial setup take?</summary><p>Most engagements go from kickoff to board-ready output in days, not months. The data cube build typically takes 2–4 weeks depending on source system complexity.</p></details>
    <details><summary>What systems do you connect to?</summary><p>CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot), billing (Stripe, Zuora, Chargebee), ERP (NetSuite, Sage Intacct), and data warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery).</p></details>
    <details><summary>How is this different from FP&A tools?</summary><p>FP&A tools start with the GL. We start with transactional customer data to build M&A-grade ARR decomposition, cohort retention, and expansion analytics that FP&A tools cannot produce.</p></details>
    <details><summary>What does pricing look like?</summary><p>Pacer AI uses an alignment-based pricing model to align Pacer AI with its clients’ goals.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Do you work with PE funds directly?</summary><p>Yes. We work with operating partners and deal teams on both pre-close diligence and post-close value creation across the portfolio.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Who should own revenue forecasting — RevOps or Finance?</summary><p>Ownership sits with RevOps; the definitions sit with Finance. The common failure is a forecast owned by RevOps that never reconciles to Finance’s reported ARR. Pacer AI recommends building the forecast off the same governed data the finance number comes from, so there is one set of definitions and one answer.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Why don’t our CRM and finance ARR numbers match?</summary><p>CRM and finance ARR numbers don’t match because they measure two different events: the CRM records bookings when a deal closes, while Finance records revenue as it is recognized — net of contraction, churn, and timing. Without a defined bridge between bookings and recognized revenue, both numbers are correct and neither reconciles. Pacer AI builds that bridge at the account-product grain, so pipeline ties to reported ARR to the dollar.</p></details>
    <details><summary>What does a VP of Revenue Operations actually own?</summary><p>A VP of Revenue Operations owns four things: the revenue forecast and pipeline cadence, the governed revenue KPI set, quota and territory capacity, and the GTM tech stack. Across the 30 B2B SaaS job descriptions Pacer AI analyzed in 2026, all four were owned by a person, not produced by a system — which is why the role turns over.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Is Pacer AI just software, or do you help?</summary><p>Both. Pacer AI is a Service-as-a-Software model — you buy the finished revenue model, not a tool to build it. The agent does the heavy modeling, and every engagement includes founder-led service, done-with-you or done-for-you, so the model is built, reconciled, and defended by a person. After implementation you run your own modeling, planning, forecasting, and reporting — DIY — with a human in the loop whenever you need one: dedicated office hours, Slack support, and ad-hoc meetings.</p></details>
